fields.signature: <location identity> + bug_class — normalized location identity. Source review: file:line + class. Black-box: endpoint + parameter + class (put the endpoint identity in file, line: 0). Normalize before writing
fields.description: one paragraph: invariant violated + why reachable
fields.attacker_model: declared attacker context, e.g. remote-unauth | authed-other-tenant
fields.poc_raw_http: raw HTTP request string, empty if not yet built
fields.marker: correlation token 'poc-<finding-id>-<random4>' embedded in the payload; ties evidence to this finding. A marker alone is NOT proof — verified:true needs evidence demonstrating the BOUNDARY crossed (see prompts/write-poc.md)
fields.evidence: required for verified:true — must show the boundary crossing with controls: {'request': '<raw req(s) sent>', 'response_excerpt': '<the part showing the marker AND the boundary crossing>'}. For access control also include positive_control and negative_control results (owner can, attacker denied on non-owned id)
